account.title: Account & Quota
account.subtitle: The plan is the capacity boundary. Overages trigger automatic scale-out or plan upgrades, with clear, auditable costs.
account.billingNote: Plans are implemented via ResourceQuota + node pool leases, decoupled from the SKE distribution — customers only see the plan concept.

upgradeModal.title: Upgrade Plan
upgradeModal.note: After upgrading, NodePoolLease scales out automatically with zero perceived downtime.
